name: Dr Zaney's Mixed Reality Arcade
summary:
Prepare to be transported to a futuristic wonderland with Dr. Zaney's Mixed Reality Arcade! Using the latest Mixed Reality technology, your living room will be transformed into the ultimate gaming destination, where you can test your skills and reflexes with a variety of thrilling mini-games. 

Take on classic favorites like Alley Bowl, Hoop Master, Whack a Max, Spilt Milk and Ring Toss.

In future updates discover additional challenges with NEW carnival games!

But that's not all! Dr. Zaney's Mixed Reality
